pipeline_contract.name: straddie-tender-timeline-v1
pipeline_contract.description: Pipeline-readable tender and procurement records for Straddie-connected opportunities. Records must be source-backed, dated, and tagged for downstream grants, ledger, events, film-club, cinematic-universe, game-world/web3 theory, resilience, digital twin, Mineral Moonshots and Civilisation of Sand pipelines.
pipeline_contract.update_rule: Add or update records only from official source pages or official tender portals. Use tbc for uncertain dates. Do not infer an open tender from a policy page, media release, strategy page or old awarded contract.

records.title: Redland City Council tender source watch
records.summary: Weekly check lane for current and upcoming Redland City Council tenders, VendorPanel pathways and awarded contract learning.
records.next_action: Search place and service terms, then add a new timeline record only when an official opportunity is open, upcoming or newly awarded.

records.title: VP513605 Park Asset Renewals
records.summary: Redland City Council seeks a principal contractor for park upgrade works at various locations across Redland City. Tenderers can tender for one or more package and documents are available through VendorPanel.
records.next_action: Check the VendorPanel tender pack, package locations and local supplier or subcontractor fit before treating this as a live bid lead.

records.title: VP514406 Footpath Upgrade and Expansion
records.summary: Redland City Council seeks a head contractor for footpath renewals and expansions at Capalaba, Victoria Point and Ormiston separable portions. Tender documents are available through VendorPanel.
records.next_action: Check the VendorPanel tender pack, separable portion requirements and subcontractor fit before deciding whether this is a lead, partner or learning record.

records.title: PDG-20842-1 Skate Bowl Refurbishment Windemere Road Park, Alexandra Hills
records.summary: Redland City Council seeks a principal contractor for design and construction of a skate park at Windemere Road Park, Alexandra Hills. Council lists a 2:00 pm 6 August 2026 close. The active VFG/Luke workflow uses 5 August as the internal finish line.
records.next_action: Complete the requirements matrix, field-proof the Aura Scan to Twin evidence path, lock partner and specialist inputs, and freeze the approved response by 5 August.

records.title: PDG-20857-1 Shade Sail - Lions Boulevard Park, Russell Island Redland City
records.summary: Redland City Council seeks a principal contractor for shade sail construction and additional seating works at Lions Boulevard Park, Russell Island. Tender documents are available through VendorPanel.
records.next_action: Do not treat as open. Keep as a learning record for island-capable shade, seating and small park works.

records.title: PDG-43883-1 Design and Construct Revetment Wall Stabilisation - Sternlight Court Cleveland (Raby Bay)
records.summary: Redland City Council seeks a principal contractor for design and construction of revetment wall stabilisation works at Sternlight Court, Cleveland. Tender documents are available through VendorPanel.
records.next_action: Do not treat as open. Use the record for coastal works capability mapping and future revetment or erosion-related procurement learning.

records.title: PDG-43894-1 Principal Cycle Network Projects Various Locations, Redland City
records.summary: Redland City Council listed a head contractor tender for three active transport projects, including Principal Cycle Network and Moreton Bay Cycleway works. The listed closing date has passed.
records.next_action: Do not treat as open. Keep as a learning record for active transport procurement patterns and future Redland or island-adjacent cycleway opportunities.

records.title: EOI000006 Lease of German Church Road Quarry and Fisherman's No. 1 Quarry
records.summary: Redland City Council seeks expressions of interest from suitably qualified and experienced operators to lease and operate German Church Road Quarry and Fisherman's No. 1 Quarry. Council lists VendorPanel reference VP518743 and a 2:00 pm 28 August 2026 close.
records.next_action: Check the VendorPanel EOI pack, quarry operating requirements, approvals, insurance and local supplier or partner fit before treating this as a live bid lead.

records.title: PDG-41634-1 2026/27 Drainage, Kerb, Concrete and Associated Works, Redland City
records.summary: Redland City Council seeks a head contractor to complete identified civil works before road resurfacing works commence. Tender documents are available through VendorPanel.
records.next_action: Check the VendorPanel tender pack, work locations, civil contractor requirements and subcontractor fit before deciding whether this is a bid, partner or learning record.

records.title: Queensland Government tender source watch
records.summary: Weekly QTenders, eTender and Queensland supplier search lane for Minjerribah, Redland, transport, tourism, environment, resilience, digital and community service terms.
records.next_action: Search QTenders, eTender and related Queensland procurement guidance. Record only official opportunity links and dates.

records.title: Dunwich (Gumpi) Ferry Terminal Upgrade
records.summary: Official $41 million SEQ City Deal commitment led by Queensland Government with Australian Government and Redland City Council funding. The project is in planning; its business case is expected in late 2026 and planning is expected to complete in 2027.
records.next_action: Do not treat as an open tender. Track TMR, QTenders and forward procurement; map likely packages, prequalification, prime partners and local supplier evidence.

records.title: Australian Government tender source watch
records.summary: Weekly AusTender lane for federal opportunities and panels that could matter to local suppliers, partners or capability-building pipelines.
records.next_action: Search current approaches to market, planned procurements and contract notices. Keep federal leads separate from grants.

records.title: First Nations procurement and partnership watch
records.summary: Policy and opportunity watch for Indigenous procurement settings, Queensland Procurement Policy 2026 participation context and permission-sensitive partnership readiness.
records.next_action: Check official policy and live tender records, then verify ownership, authority, eligibility and permission boundaries before any pipeline acts.
